شَبُّورٌ A trumpet; syn. بُوقٌ; (S, K;) a certain thing in which one blows: (Mgh:) said to be an arabicized word; (S;) not genuine Arabic: (Mgh, TA:) accord. to IAth, it is Hebrew: (TA:) [app. from the Hebr. שׁוֹפָּר , as observed by Golius.] ―
-b2- See also أُشْبُورٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
